mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in CPIAUCSL above 3% over three consecutive months signals persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates, which reduces present value of future corporate earnings and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or CPIAUCSL exceeds 3% for three months without a subsequent rate hike.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in GDPC1 of more than 2% signals a significant weakening in aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered episodes, or GDP growth recovers above trend within 6 months without equity decline.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase of at least 0.4 percentage points in UNRATE for three consecutive months signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and leads to higher input costs and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days in late-cycle conditions.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises by >0.4pp for three consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of triggered late-cycle episodes, or wage growth decelerates before equity decline.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in PAYEMS and a fall in UNRATE above 0.3 percentage points in the same month signals a mismatch between job creation and labor force growth, indicating softening labor market quality and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > previous month AND UNRATE < previous month AND UNRATE change < -0.3pp
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered months, or the labor market mismatch does not persist for more than one month.

mechanism_narrative: A two-month consecutive decline in INDPRO of more than 1% signals weakening industrial production, which reduces corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls by >1.0% for two consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of triggered episodes, or INDPRO rebounds above trend within one month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in HOUST above 2% for three consecutive months signals robust housing demand, which boosts construction and related equities, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST > previous month AND HOUST change > 2.0% for three consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or HOUST growth decelerates before equity gains materialize.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in FEDFUNDS and a fall in RSAFS by more than 1% in the same month signals a tightening monetary stance with reduced liquidity, which depresses risk asset valuations and produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > previous month AND RSAFS < previous month AND RSAFS change < -1.0%
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of triggered episodes, or liquidity conditions normalize before equity decline.

mechanism_narrative: An annualized quarterly growth in GDPC1 above 4% for two consecutive quarters signals a strong demand expansion, which raises earnings expectations and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 quarterly growth > 4.0% for two consecutive quarters
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or GDP growth slows below 2% within the next quarter.
